current_answer: At about 13:34 UTC on October 14, 2026, Kalshi’s October Chance headings showed 53% “Fed maintains rate” and 47% “Hike 25bps”; Polymarket’s separate named rows showed 47% “No change” and 52% “25 bps increase.” Kalshi narrowly favored a hold, while Polymarket narrowly favored a 25-basis-point hike. Against the October 13 19:06 UTC check, Kalshi’s hold heading fell 29 percentage points and its hike heading rose 28; Polymarket’s no-change row fell 33 points and its hike row rose 32. The market checks straddle CPI, but do not prove it caused the full move. The Beige Book is scheduled for 14:00 ET (18:00 UTC).
